description.en: Keep this cell as published. This is a site without a stable grid for a pump motor. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Open the diesel 511 only when 380 V is absent. Read it in the Xingtai table. Output stays 3 m³/h and particle ≤6 mm. Taken from the printed row: The page prints a diesel engine, not a kilowatt cell. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 511 Diesel at diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No kilowatt figure is printed. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not move the same condition onto Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine, which prints diesel engine 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 80 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm and 480 kg. Taken from the printed row: The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Keep this cell as published. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This note names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 这是泵用电机没有稳定电网的现场。只有没有 380V 时才打开柴油 511。输送量仍是 3 m³/h，粒径 ≤6 mm。这一页印的是柴油机，不是千瓦格。邢台河北品锦机械把511柴油型列为柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、水平 30 m / 垂直 15 m、管径 32/38 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm、360 kg。没有印千瓦数字。先不要把同一工况挪到柴油混凝土喷涂机，那一行印的是柴油机 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、8 MPa、水平 80 m / 垂直 40 m、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm、480 kg。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
